notes.title: PLAYTEST!
notes.content:
I am glad to announce the [color="#00fc90"]date of the playtest![/color]


📅 You can play from [color="#00fc90"]Friday (12.09)[/color] to [color="#00fc90"]Sunday (14.09)[/color] inclusive.

🌍 Servers will be deployed in New York (GMT-4), Frankfurt (GMT +2) and Hong Kong (GMT +8) to cover up to 75% of playtest requests.

⏰ For a more exciting gaming experience among other players, it is recommended to [color="#00fc90"]play at 16:00[/color]!

👫 You can also [color="#00fc90"]invite up to 3 of your friends[/color] to the playtest. Try to evacuate one NPC and save your friendship!

💬 Any [color="#00fc90"]feedback[/color] can be left in the [color="#00fc90"]Google form[/color], or on our [color="#00fc90"]Discord server[/color].

Good luck, [color="#00fc90"] Reclaimers![/color]

notes.title: WE HAVE BEEN COOKING!🧑‍🍳
notes.content:
[color="#00fc90"]Hi, 🧑‍💻 Delevoper is here![/color]



We're excited to show you what we've been working on for the past month! Get ready for:


 A slick, localized UI 🔧

 A brand-new training map 🗺️

 Smoother shooting mechanics 🔫

 A complete endurance system overhaul 💪

 ...and a TON of bug squashing! 🐛


[color="#00fc90"]Playtest this month 10,000%[/color]

notes.title: Icons, animations, sounds
Three factory workers make a game
notes.content:
[color="#00fc90"]Who are we?[/color]

Indie developers who create their first game in the evenings and on weekends without publishers and funding.

[color="#00fc90"]Do you really work at a factory?[/color]

Yes, it's true, at different enterprises and in different cities, but yes.
P.S. The photo shows me ːsteamhappyː

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45633469/835880b8ae6de00759cf78f98cdaaa71c7ea20cd.jpg

[color="#00fc90"]What are your plans for the game?[/color]

Oh, it's hard to say. At first, we did it as a hobby, but now it has grown into a full-fledged development.
 
[color="#00fc90"]Are you planning to quit your job, get divorced, get a cat, and spend 3 years in the garage making a game?[/color]

Ha-ha, no, definitely not. Although for the sake of the title on reddit...
 
[color="#00fc90"]When are you planning the playtest?[/color]

If only I knew. I'm kidding. It's late June, early July. We just want to get more test applications.

[color="#00fc90"]Who does what in the team?[/color]

Supromental is a programmer and works on the code. Owner does everything else. I Am Groot ːNewZombieː
 
[color="#00fc90"]What do you usually do in your regular job?[/color]
 
Ugh, a lot of things. For example, we drink tea, tell jokes, and sometimes climb towers. 

[color="#00fc90"]What do you want to say to those who read this?[/color]

Thank you for reading this far. I appreciate it.

Also, if you haven't added the game to your wishlist and signed up for the playtest, I think you know what to do.
 
If you want to talk about the game or the content creator, you can write to the following email: Arskrisan@gmail.сom

I'll leave the press kit here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xL2ujdipnh26w7F88OzRNTP2p2v3OMNK?usp=sharing

[color="#00fc90"]And the last question. Why don't you make a game in the automation genre?[/color]

Hmm, good question. Damn. Why didn't you ask me that a year ago? A-A-A-A-A-A-A-A-A-A-A-A-A-A-A-A
